css: body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; color: #1a1a2e; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; } h1 { font-size: 2em; color: #0f3460; border-bottom: 3px solid #0f3460; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-top: 40px; } h2 { font-size: 1.4em; color: #16213e; border-left: 4px solid #e94560; padding-left: 12px; margin-top: 30px; } h3 { font-size: 1.1em; color: #0f3460; margin-top: 20px; } code { background: #f0f4ff; color: #d63031; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Consolas', monospace; font-size: 0.9em; } pre { background: #1a1a2e; color: #e0e0e0; padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Consolas', monospace; font-size: 0.85em; line-height: 1.6; border-left: 4px solid #e94560; } pre code { background: none; color: inherit; padding: 0; } table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 16px 0; } th { background: #0f3460; color: white; padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; } td { padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dde; } tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f7f9ff; } blockquote { border-left: 4px solid #0f3460; background: #eef3ff; margin: 16px 0; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; } hr { border: none; border-top: 2px solid #e0e4f0; margin: 30px 0; } strong { color: #0f3460; }
